user_query: I'm starting a new business venture and I need to make an impactful speech to announce it. Can you provide me with some inspirational quotes and words to start with? Additionally, I'm looking for news articles about successful entrepreneurs to gather insights and inspiration.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of inspirational quotes and impactful phrases that can be used to start the speech.
Search for news articles about successful entrepreneurs to gain insights and inspiration for the speech.
